messages:
Mira: Quick follow-up on the 'multi-region handshake' RFC. Thought: can we push tenant locality decision to the edge proxy instead of routing every decision through the central control plane? Would cut cross-region chatter and speed up cutovers.

Juan: Edge-first reduces control-plane load for sure, but legal residency is the gotcha. EU-only tenants cannot have data leave eu regions at all. How do we guarantee no accidental cross-region egress?

Olivia: Edge can enforce hard rejects if the policy says strict-residency. But that requires a reliable policy sync and a versioned policy store on the edge. My worry: policy drift during staged rollouts leads to silently serving in incorrect region.

Ryan: We probably need a hybrid approach. Options:
- Edge-only: local policy cache, immediate decision. Lower latency, higher risk of drift.
- Hybrid: Edge picks fast candidate and serves; control-plane validates and issues a signed attest. If validation fails, control-plane emits an eviction and edge stops serving for that tenant.

Mira: Hybrid matches our latency goals while keeping a central guardrail. Edge picks candidate to avoid added RTT, control-plane asynchronously audits and can tombstone the edge.

Juan: For tombstones we need KV cache semantics. If we evict mid-flight, how do we avoid serving stale writes from prefix cache? Need clear TTL/opinionated staleness semantics on the edge.

Olivia: Minimal header contract suggestion for downstream visibility:

``` 
X-Redwood-Region-Candidate: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Handshaked: 1
```

Edge attaches candidate + a handshake flag. Control-plane returns a signed, short-lived attest with tenant_id, region, issued_at, exp, sig. Edge caches attest (TTL aligned to exp). Keep header small (<1k).

Ryan: Signed attest seems right. Implementation details: attest format (compact JWT), verification on edge using control-plane pubkey, backoff if control-plane unreachable. Need key rotation with a grace window (old keys accepted for 1h).

Mira: Rollout plan sketch: begin with read-only tenants to limit blast radius. Canary 1% traffic in 'edge-handoff' mode. Attest beacon every 5s for health telemetry. Measure mismatch_rate and request_fallthrough. Rollback if mismatch_rate > 0.5%.

Juan: Initial metrics to add:
- handshake.mismatch_rate (edge candidate vs control-plane canonical)
- handshake.attest_latency_p50_p95
- handshake.eviction_count
- handshake.policy_staleness_alerts

Olivia: Ops playbook note: if control-plane is unreachable, edges continue to use last-known valid attest for up to 10 minutes, then switch to per-tenant configured fallback-region. Feature flag per-tenant to opt into hybrid mode.

k8s-bot: NOTE: edge-proxy image will be tagged redwood/edge-proxy:v1.3.2-canary - rollout window 18:00-20:00 UTC.

Ryan: Security: attests must be signed with control-plane KMS keys. Edge verifies sig. Key rotation path: publish new key, allow old key for 1h for verification, rotate gracefully. Audit logs for attest issuance.

Mira: Action items: Juan -> policy-sync + TTL semantics doc; Olivia -> metrics + console dashboard; Ryan -> attest PoC + key-rotation plan; Mira -> write canary checklist and follow-up RFC. I'll create PRs and tag eng-sre & infra.

Juan: OK, I'll start the policy-sync patch tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Olivia: I'll wire up the Grafana panels for mismatch_rate.

Ryan: PoC branch created, will ping once ready.

Mira: Thanks team, will post the RFC link in #architecture once it's up.
